issues.title: Let the merchant choose whether a new partner rate applies to existing customers
issues.body:
**What.** When the merchant changes the rate of a partner who has customers, a dialog asks where the new rate applies:

- **New customers only** (selected by default): the current customers keep their rate; only customers brought from now on pay the new rate.
- **All customers**: every current customer of the partner pays the new rate from the next payment.

The partner's history records the choice.

**Why.** The client answered our question 1 of 23 Oct in the letter of 30 Oct (`docs/letters/2026-10-30-client.md`): a new rate applies only to customers brought after the change, and the commissions on current customers stay as they are. On 6 Nov 2026 we decided to make that the default and to keep "All customers" as a choice in the dialog. This replaces the decision of 29 Oct, which made "All customers" the default.

**Acceptance.** A partner has 3 customers at 5%. The merchant sets 7% and keeps the default: the 3 customers still pay the partner 5%, and a new customer brought after the change pays 7%. With "All customers", the next payment of each of the 3 customers pays the partner 7%.

comments.author: kim
comments.body: Default changed to "New customers only" after the client's letter of 30 Oct; "All customers" stays a choice (decided 6 Nov 2026).

issues.title: Show the date of the next monthly payout on the partner page
issues.body: Partners are paid monthly, on the 5th. The partner page shows no date. Show the date of the next payout above the balance.

issues.title: Export the commissions of a month as CSV
issues.body: The merchant needs the commissions of a month as a CSV file for the accountant: partner, customer, payment, rate, amount.
